records.context: Build the agreement report for the ticked columns.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.agreement.AgreementScreen.compute#0
records.source: Build the agreement report for the ticked columns.
records.translation: 선택한 열의 일치도 보고서를 작성합니다.

records.context: Expected refusals, such as no database or fewer than two selected columns, are shown inline and return ``False``. Synchronous computation failures also return ``False``. In executed in a worker mode, computation failures are reported later; the method has already returned ``True`` once the job starts.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.agreement.AgreementScreen.compute#1
records.source: Expected refusals, such as no database or fewer than two selected columns, are shown inline and return ``False``. Synchronous computation failures also return ``False``. In threaded mode, computation failures are reported later; the method has already returned ``True`` once the job starts.
records.translation: 데이터베이스가 없거나 선택한 열이 두 개 미만인 경우와 같은 예상된 거부는 화면 안에 표시하고 ``False``\ 를 반환합니다. 동기 계산 실패도 ``False``\ 를 반환합니다. 스레드 모드에서는 계산 실패를 나중에 보고하며, 작업이 시작되면 메서드는 이미 ``True``\ 를 반환한 상태입니다.

records.context: for the synchronous path, whether the report was built; for the background execution path, ``True`` once the job has started.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.agreement.AgreementScreen.compute#2
records.source: for the synchronous path, whether the report was built; for the threaded path, ``True`` once the job has started.
records.translation: 동기 실행에서는 보고서가 작성되었는지 여부이며, 스레드 실행에서는 작업이 시작되면 ``True``\ 입니다.

records.context: Push name/value pairs from `settings` into whichever settings widgets this app exposes.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.app_screen.AppScreen.apply_settings_dict#0
records.source: Push key/value pairs from `settings` into whichever settings widgets this app exposes.
records.translation: `settings`\ 의 키/값 쌍을 이 앱이 제공하는 해당 설정 위젯에 적용합니다.

records.context: A bulk load is one transaction. When the form's shape changes and the host supports rebuilding, the complete merged mapping is used to request one replacement screen. If a worker is executing, that rebuild is deferred and values are applied to the current form; otherwise the replacement is built before values are applied. No signal may replace the screen halfway through the value loop. Silently skips structured-data names that the current app does not have -- the same key-value mapping can safely be applied across several apps. Returns the count of structured-data names actually applied.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.app_screen.AppScreen.apply_settings_dict#1
records.source: A bulk load is one transaction. When the form's shape changes and the host supports rebuilding, the complete merged mapping is used to request one replacement screen. If a worker is running, that rebuild is deferred and values are applied to the current form; otherwise the replacement is built before values are applied. No signal may replace the screen halfway through the value loop. Silently skips keys the current app does not have -- the same dict can safely be applied across several apps. Returns the count of keys actually applied.
records.translation: 대량 로드는 하나의 트랜잭션입니다. 폼 구조가 바뀌고 호스트가 재구성을 지원하면, 병합된 전체 매핑으로 대체 화면 하나를 요청합니다. 작업자가 실행 중이면 재구성을 미루고 현재 폼에 값을 적용하며, 그렇지 않으면 값을 적용하기 전에 대체 화면을 만듭니다. 값을 순회하는 도중에는 어떤 신호도 화면을 대체할 수 없습니다. 현재 앱에 없는 키는 조용히 건너뜁니다 -- 같은 dict를 여러 앱에 안전하게 적용할 수 있습니다. 실제 적용한 키의 수를 반환합니다.

records.context: Write the plate map through the job runner. File writing executes on a background execution unit by default, or inline when the screen is unthreaded.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.experiment_design.ExperimentDesignScreen.export_to#0
records.source: Write the plate map through the job runner. File writing runs on a worker thread by default, or inline when the screen is unthreaded.
records.translation: 작업 실행기를 통해 플레이트 맵을 씁니다. 파일 쓰기는 기본적으로 작업 스레드에서 실행하고, 화면이 스레드 없이 실행되면 호출 안에서 바로 실행합니다.

records.context: in executed in a worker mode, whether the job was started; inline, whether writing and completion handling succeeded.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.experiment_design.ExperimentDesignScreen.export_to#2
records.source: in threaded mode, whether the job was started; inline, whether writing and completion handling succeeded.
records.translation: 스레드 모드에서는 작업이 시작되었는지, 직접 실행 모드에서는 쓰기와 완료 처리가 성공했는지를 나타냅니다.

records.context: Read a text table or one measurement-database table through the job runner. Database table names are listed synchronously; table data are read on a background execution unit by default, or inline when the screen is unthreaded.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.feature_explorer.FeatureExplorerScreen.load_path#0
records.source: Read a text table or one measurement-database table through the job runner. Database table names are listed synchronously; table data are read on a worker thread by default, or inline when the screen is unthreaded.
records.translation: 작업 실행기를 통해 텍스트 테이블 또는 측정 데이터베이스의 테이블 하나를 읽습니다. 데이터베이스 테이블 이름은 동기적으로 나열합니다. 테이블 데이터는 기본적으로 작업 스레드에서 읽고, 화면이 스레드 없이 실행되면 호출 안에서 바로 읽습니다.

records.context: the database table to read; ``None`` uses the first listed table after the picker is rebuilt.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.feature_explorer.FeatureExplorerScreen.load_path#2
records.source: the database table to read; ``None`` uses the first listed table after the picker is rebuilt.
records.translation: 읽을 데이터베이스 테이블입니다. ``None``\ 이면 선택기를 다시 구성한 뒤 나열된 첫 번째 테이블을 사용합니다.

records.context: CSV, TSV, text, or SQLite database path. Delimited files are read directly; every other suffix is opened as SQLite in read-only mode.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.graph_builder.read_table#1
records.source: CSV, TSV, text, or SQLite database path. Delimited files are read directly; every other suffix is opened as SQLite in read-only mode.
records.translation: CSV, TSV, 텍스트 파일 또는 SQLite 데이터베이스 경로입니다. 구분자가 있는 파일은 직접 읽고, 다른 모든 확장자는 읽기 전용 모드의 SQLite로 엽니다.

records.context: optional row cap. Delimited-file readers apply it while reading; ordinary SQLite tables use sql limit. Named derived tables are evaluated first and then truncated in memory, so this cap does not bound their evaluation cost. The chart's separate large-data policy applies after loading.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.graph_builder.read_table#2
records.source: optional row cap. Delimited-file readers apply it while reading; ordinary SQLite tables use SQL LIMIT. Named derived tables are evaluated first and then truncated in memory, so this cap does not bound their evaluation cost. The chart's separate large-data policy applies after loading.
records.translation: 선택적인 행 수 제한입니다. 구분자로 나뉜 파일의 읽기 도구는 읽는 동안 제한을 적용하고, 일반 SQLite 테이블은 SQL LIMIT를 사용합니다. 이름이 있는 파생 테이블은 먼저 계산한 뒤 메모리에서 잘라내므로, 이 제한은 계산 비용을 제한하지 않습니다. 차트의 별도 대용량 데이터 정책은 로드한 뒤 적용됩니다.

records.context: the raw field contents, e.g. ``"5, 15, 50"``.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.hyperparam.parse_values#1
records.source: the raw field contents, e.g. ``"5, 15, 50"``.
records.translation: 입력 필드의 원시 내용입니다. 예: ``"5, 15, 50"``.

records.context: ``'int'`` and ``'float'`` convert numeric values; ``'metric'`` validates against the available UMAP metrics. Other values, including ``'str'``, retain text.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.hyperparam.parse_values#2
records.source: ``'int'`` and ``'float'`` convert numeric values; ``'metric'`` validates against the available UMAP metrics. Other values, including ``'str'``, retain text.
records.translation: ``'int'`` 와 ``'float'`` 는 숫자 값을 변환하고, ``'metric'`` 은 사용 가능한 UMAP 메트릭에 맞는지 검증합니다. ``'str'`` 을 포함한 나머지 값은 텍스트를 유지합니다.

records.context: with a sentence the panel shows inline when a value does not match ``kind``.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.hyperparam.parse_values#5
records.source: with a sentence the panel shows inline when a value does not match ``kind``.
records.translation: 값이 ``kind``\ 와 맞지 않을 때 패널에 바로 표시할 설명 문장을 포함합니다.

records.context: Write the current sections to a Markdown file, appending the digest when available.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.methods_export.MethodsExportScreen.export#0
records.source: Write the current sections to a Markdown file, appending the digest when available.
records.translation: 현재 섹션을 Markdown 파일에 쓰고, 요약 기록이 있으면 덧붙입니다.

records.context: When a digest is available, it is written into the same file as an appendix so the record the text was written from stays with it.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.methods_export.MethodsExportScreen.export#1
records.source: When a digest is available, it is written into the same file as an appendix so the record the text was written from stays with it.
records.translation: 요약 기록이 있으면 같은 파일에 부록으로 기록하여, 텍스트 작성의 근거가 된 기록이 함께 보존되게 합니다.

records.context: where to write.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.methods_export.MethodsExportScreen.export#2
records.source: where to write.
records.translation: 파일을 쓸 위치입니다.

records.context: the path written, or ``""`` when there was nothing to write.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.methods_export.MethodsExportScreen.export#3
records.source: the path written, or ``""`` when there was nothing to write.
records.translation: 기록한 파일 경로이며, 쓸 내용이 없으면 ``""``\ 입니다.

records.context: Write the flags out: the whole table, the flagged rows, the microplate sample positions.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.outliers.OutliersScreen.export_csv#0
records.source: Write the flags out: the whole table, the flagged rows, the wells.
records.translation: 플래그 결과를 파일로 씁니다. 전체 테이블, 플래그가 지정된 행, 웰 결과를 기록합니다.

records.context: A successful export writes two CSV files: the *whole* table with added columns, keeping every object, and the rows selected by the same flags the screen uses. A third CSV summarizes microplate sample positions when well results are available. A text report is written alongside these files.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.outliers.OutliersScreen.export_csv#1
records.source: A successful export writes two CSV files: the *whole* table with added columns, keeping every object, and the rows selected by the same flags the screen uses. A third CSV summarizes wells when well results are available. A text report is written alongside these files.
records.translation: 내보내기에 성공하면 CSV 파일 두 개를 씁니다. 하나는 모든 객체를 유지하면서 열을 추가한 *전체* 테이블이고, 다른 하나는 화면이 사용하는 것과 같은 플래그로 선택한 행입니다. 웰 결과가 있으면 세 번째 CSV에 웰 요약을 씁니다. 이 파일들과 함께 텍스트 보고서도 기록합니다.

review_method: AI technical authoring and independent AI technical/language peer review against exact screen implementations and source/context bindings. Only demonstrated contract and companion-translation defects changed. No human or native-speaker signoff.
